description: Client-side script managing UI interactions such as menu toggle, header background change on scroll, swiper initialization, section highlighting, scroll-up button, cart display, and dark/light theme toggle.

methods.name: scrollHeader
methods.description: Adds or removes 'scroll-header' class to header based on scroll position.

methods.name: linkAction
methods.description: Removes 'show-menu' class from navigation menu when a navigation link is clicked.

methods.name: scrollActive
methods.description: Highlights the navigation link corresponding to the currently viewed section.

methods.name: scrollUp
methods.description: Shows or hides the scroll-up button based on scroll position.
